title: ACT/360 year fraction (money-market basis)
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M] (ISO start, end). DITANYAKAN: calendar days and ACT/360 year fraction per row. RUMUS: card Core 1: yf = days/360, days = end - start (start inclusive, end exclusive); toolkit year_fraction(start, end, basis) supports ACT/365 (Fixed), ACT/360, ACT/ACT (days/365.25 approximation only), 30/360 (US), 30E/360. JAWAB: 1) parse dates. 2) days = (end - start).days. 3) yf = days/360. 4) check yf > ACT/365F yf by 365/360.

title: ACT/365 Fixed year fraction
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M], possibly spanning Feb 29. DITANYAKAN: ACT/365F year fraction. RUMUS: card Core 1: days/365 even in leap years; year_fraction(s, e, 'act/365'). JAWAB: 1) days. 2) /365. 3) note leap day counted as a day but denominator stays 365.

title: ACT/ACT ISDA with calendar-year split
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M] spanning year boundaries. DITANYAKAN: ACT/ACT ISDA year fraction. RUMUS: card Core 2: days in leap years/366 + days in non-leap/365, split at Jan 1; toolkit ACT/ACT is only days/365.25 - implement ISDA manually. JAWAB: 1) iterate years from start to end. 2) segment days per year (start inclusive, Jan 1 boundaries). 3) sum seg/basis_year. 4) check one full calendar year = 1.
formulas: yf = sum_y days_in_y / (366 if leap(y) else 365)
pitfalls: splitting by period year instead of Jan 1

title: ACT/ACT ICMA accrual fraction for bonds
deliverables: per-row table: accrued days, period days, year_fraction, accrued amount
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [M]: previous and next coupon dates, settlement, freq f, coupon c, face. DITANYAKAN: ICMA year fraction and accrued interest. RUMUS: card Core 3: yf = days_accrued/(f days_in_period); full period = 1/f. JAWAB: 1) PCD, NCD. 2) A = settle - PCD; E = NCD - PCD. 3) yf = A/(f E). 4) AI = c F yf. 5) check AI = 0 on PCD.

title: 30/360 US bond basis
deliverables: per-row table: D1, D2, days_360, year_fraction
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M]. DITANYAKAN: 30/360 US days and fraction. RUMUS: card Core 4: D1 = min(d1,30); D2 = 30 if D1 == 30 and d2 == 31 else d2; toolkit year_fraction(start, end, basis) supports ACT/365 (Fixed), ACT/360, ACT/ACT (days/365.25 approximation only), 30/360 (US), 30E/360. JAWAB: 1) adjust. 2) days = 360 dY + 30 dM + D2 - D1. 3) /360. 4) test cases ending on 31st with start < 30.

title: 30/360 US SIA with end-of-February rules
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M] incl. Feb month-ends. DITANYAKAN: SIA 30/360 fraction. RUMUS: card Core 4 SIA: bond basis plus d1 last day Feb -> D1 = 30; both last day Feb -> D2 = 30. JAWAB: 1) detect last day of Feb (28 or 29). 2) apply rules in order. 3) compute. 4) contrast with bond basis.

title: 30E/360 Eurobond basis
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M]. DITANYAKAN: 30E/360 fraction. RUMUS: card Core 4: D1 = min(d1,30), D2 = min(d2,30); year_fraction(s, e, '30E/360'). JAWAB: 1) clip both. 2) days_360. 3) /360.

title: 30E/360 ISDA with February and maturity exception
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M], flag whether end is the termination (maturity) date. DITANYAKAN: 30E/360 ISDA fraction. RUMUS: card Core 4: as 30E/360 plus last day of Feb -> 30, except D2 on the termination date. JAWAB: 1) month-end detection. 2) D1 rule. 3) D2 rule with maturity exception. 4) compute.
formulas: D = 30 if last day of month (Feb incl.), except D2 at maturity in Feb

title: Comparison table of day-count bases on the same dates
deliverables: per-row x basis table [M x K]
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs [M]; list of bases [K]. DITANYAKAN: year fraction for each pair and basis. RUMUS: card Core 1-4; year_fraction for the bases it supports, manual for ISDA/ICMA/SIA. JAWAB: 1) loop bases. 2) compute. 3) check ACT/360 > ACT/365F; 30/360 vs ACT differences at month ends.

title: Deposit interest amount by currency money-market basis
frame: DIKETAHUI: deposits [M]: currency, notional, rate (percent), start, end; optional basis column. DITANYAKAN: basis used and interest amount per trade. RUMUS: card Conventions: ACT/360 USD/EUR/JPY/CHF...; ACT/365F GBP/AUD/NZD/CAD/HKD...; file column overrides; toolkit money_market_year_fraction(days, currency, basis). JAWAB: 1) basis per row. 2) days. 3) yf. 4) interest = N r yf. 5) report.

title: Following business day convention
frame: DIKETAHUI: dates [M]; holidays [H]. DITANYAKAN: Following-adjusted date (ISO). RUMUS: card Core 5: next good day (not weekend, not holiday). JAWAB: 1) holiday set (parsed dates). 2) while not good: +1 day. 3) ISO output.

title: Modified Following convention
deliverables: per-date table: unadjusted, adjusted, rule applied
frame: DIKETAHUI: dates [M]; holidays [H]. DITANYAKAN: Modified Following adjusted date. RUMUS: card Core 5: following unless month changes, then preceding. JAWAB: 1) following. 2) if month differs: preceding. 3) check never crosses month end.
formulas: MF(d) = F(d) if month(F(d)) = month(d) else P(d)

title: Preceding and Modified Preceding conventions
frame: DIKETAHUI: dates; holidays; rule. DITANYAKAN: adjusted date. RUMUS: card Core 5: preceding = previous good day; modified preceding: following if month changes. JAWAB: 1) rule. 2) adjust. 3) check month.

title: Holiday calendar construction, weekends-only default
deliverables: summary: calendar used; table of business-day flags
frame: DIKETAHUI: holiday list [H] (strings) or none. DITANYAKAN: calendar function / flags. RUMUS: card Completing: no holiday file -> Mon-Fri only (state it); parse strings to dates. JAWAB: 1) parse. 2) set. 3) is_good(d) = weekday < 5 and d not in H. 4) np.busdaycalendar(holidays=H) optional.
formulas: good(d) = weekday(d) < 5 and d not in H

title: Add n business days to a date
frame: DIKETAHUI: dates [M], n [M], holidays. DITANYAKAN: date + n good days. RUMUS: np.busday_offset(d, n, roll='forward', holidays=H) or loop. JAWAB: 1) loop counting good days. 2) result. 3) check result is good day.
formulas: result = n-th good day after d

title: FX spot date with joint calendar (T+2)
deliverables: per-trade table: trade date, spot date
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [M]: trade date, pair; holidays per currency. DITANYAKAN: spot date per trade. RUMUS: card Core 7: add N good days in BOTH currencies (and USD for crosses at settlement). JAWAB: 1) parse pair. 2) calendars. 3) count good days in joint calendar. 4) USD rule for crosses. 5) ISO.
pitfalls: skipping a holiday in only one currency

title: FX spot T+1 pairs (USD/CAD, USD/TRY, USD/RUB, USD/PHP)
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [M] with pairs. DITANYAKAN: spot date using pair-specific lag. RUMUS: card Conventions: FX T+2 except listed pairs T+1. JAWAB: 1) lag per pair. 2) joint calendar. 3) spot.

title: FX forward delivery date from tenor with EOM
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade dates; tenors [M]; calendars. DITANYAKAN: delivery date per trade. RUMUS: card Core 7: delivery = spot + n months, roll MF; EOM if spot is last business day of month. JAWAB: 1) spot. 2) add months (clip). 3) EOM rule. 4) MF adjust in joint calendar.

title: Broken-date forward: days from spot and interpolated points
deliverables: per-trade table: days_from_spot, interpolated points, outright
frame: DIKETAHUI: spot date; standard tenor dates and points; broken delivery date. DITANYAKAN: days from spot and interpolated points / outright. RUMUS: card Core 7: days = delivery - spot; linear interpolation of points in days. JAWAB: 1) tenor dates. 2) days. 3) interp. 4) outright = spot + points/multiplier.

title: Schedule generation backward from maturity with short front stub
deliverables: schedule table [n]: start, end, payment, year_fraction
frame: DIKETAHUI: effective date, maturity, freq, BDC, calendar. DITANYAKAN: periods with adjusted dates and fractions. RUMUS: card V4 (a): maturity - k months (from anchor), stop at effective; front stub short. JAWAB: 1) unadjusted dates from maturity back. 2) prepend effective. 3) adjust. 4) fractions. 5) sum ~ tenor.

title: Forward generation with back stub
frame: DIKETAHUI: effective date, maturity, freq; forward generation stated. DITANYAKAN: periods with back stub. RUMUS: card V4 (b). JAWAB: 1) effective + k months. 2) last before maturity, then maturity. 3) adjust. 4) fractions.

title: Long vs short stub choice
frame: DIKETAHUI: dates, freq, stub type stated. DITANYAKAN: schedule with long or short stub. RUMUS: long stub merges the short stub with neighbouring regular period. JAWAB: 1) short schedule. 2) if long: drop the boundary date. 3) fractions; ICMA stub coupon via notional periods.
formulas: long stub = short stub + adjacent period

title: End-of-month rule schedules
frame: DIKETAHUI: anchor date at month end; freq. DITANYAKAN: schedule with EOM roll. RUMUS: card Core 6, V5 (a): if anchor is month end every date is month end. JAWAB: 1) detect month end. 2) month-end dates. 3) BDC. 4) compare with same-day roll.

title: Roll from anchor vs cumulative month addition
frame: DIKETAHUI: anchor, n periods. DITANYAKAN: dates rolled from anchor. RUMUS: card Pitfalls: anchor + k months, never repeated addition. JAWAB: 1) for k: anchor + relativedelta(months=k m). 2) clip. 3) adjust.

title: Swap leg accrual on adjusted vs unadjusted dates
frame: DIKETAHUI: schedule; BDC; instrument type. DITANYAKAN: accrual fractions on correct endpoints. RUMUS: card V6: swaps accrue adjusted; bonds unadjusted. JAWAB: 1) both date sets. 2) choose. 3) yf. 4) payments on adjusted dates.

title: Payment dates with payment lag
deliverables: schedule table: accrual end, payment date
frame: DIKETAHUI: schedule; lag n business days. DITANYAKAN: payment dates. RUMUS: pay = accrual_end + n good days. JAWAB: 1) adjusted ends. 2) add lag. 3) ISO.

title: Bond accrued interest at settlement (ICMA)
deliverables: per-trade table: settle, accrued days, AI
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades: trade date, lag, bond coupon schedule, c, f, face. DITANYAKAN: settlement date and accrued interest. RUMUS: card Conventions UST T+1; Core 3. JAWAB: 1) settle. 2) PCD/NCD. 3) AI. 4) dirty = clean + AI.

title: Corporate bond accrued on 30/360 at T+2 settlement
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades: trade date, coupon schedule, c, face. DITANYAKAN: settle, accrued days (30/360), AI. RUMUS: card Conventions US corporates 30/360 SIA. JAWAB: 1) settle (stated lag). 2) days_360. 3) AI. 4) invoice.

title: Treasury settlement T+1 and next/previous coupon dates
deliverables: per-bond table: settle, PCD, NCD, DSC, E
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds: maturity, f; trade dates. DITANYAKAN: settlement, PCD, NCD, days counts. RUMUS: coupon dates = maturity - k (12/f) months (EOM if maturity month end). JAWAB: 1) settle. 2) dates. 3) PCD <= settle < NCD. 4) DSC, E.

title: Gilt ex-dividend date
deliverables: per-trade table: ex date, ex flag, AI
frame: DIKETAHUI: gilts; settlement; UK calendar. DITANYAKAN: ex date and accrued (negative if ex). RUMUS: ex date = coupon date - 7 business days; AI negative in ex period (ACT/ACT ICMA). JAWAB: 1) ex date. 2) flag. 3) AI.

title: Stub coupon amount under ICMA vs 30/360
frame: DIKETAHUI: irregular period; regular period; basis. DITANYAKAN: stub coupon amount. RUMUS: card Completing: ICMA = full coupon (stub days / regular days); 30/360 or ACT/360: c F yf(stub). JAWAB: 1) basis. 2) yf. 3) coupon.

title: USD SOFR OIS fixed leg schedule and amounts
deliverables: schedule table: start, end, yf, amount
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade date, tenor, notional, fixed rate; USD calendar. DITANYAKAN: fixed leg schedule and coupon amounts. RUMUS: card Conventions SOFR OIS annual ACT/360, T+2; MF. JAWAB: 1) spot. 2) backward schedule. 3) adjust. 4) yf ACT/360. 5) amounts N K yf. 6) payment lag if given.

title: Float leg fixing dates with fixing lag
frame: DIKETAHUI: float schedule; fixing lag n. DITANYAKAN: fixing dates. RUMUS: fixing = accrual_start - n good days (index calendar). JAWAB: 1) starts. 2) subtract lag. 3) ISO.

title: Compounded SOFR in arrears with lookback / observation shift
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily fixings; period; lookback days; method. DITANYAKAN: compounded rate and amount. RUMUS: R = (prod (1 + r_i n_i/360) - 1) 360/D; lookback uses r from i - p days, weights n_i from period (lag) or from observation period (shift). JAWAB: 1) observation dates. 2) weights. 3) product. 4) rate, amount.

title: Tenor labels to year fractions without dates
frame: DIKETAHUI: tenor strings [M]; currency basis. DITANYAKAN: approximate year fractions. RUMUS: card Completing: 1M = 1/12, 3M = 0.25, 1W = 7/365 (or /360), ON = 1 day. JAWAB: 1) parse. 2) map. 3) report rule.

title: Business days between two dates
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs; holidays. DITANYAKAN: count of good days in [start, end). RUMUS: np.busday_count(start, end, holidays=H). JAWAB: 1) calendar. 2) count. 3) note inclusivity.

title: BUS/252 day count (Brazil)
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs; Brazilian holidays. DITANYAKAN: BUS/252 fraction and compounded factor. RUMUS: yf = business days / 252; factor (1 + r)^{yf}. JAWAB: 1) count. 2) /252. 3) factor.

title: NL/365 and ACT/365.25 variants
frame: DIKETAHUI: date pairs; stated basis. DITANYAKAN: fraction under variant. RUMUS: NL/365: days excluding Feb 29 / 365; ACT/365.25 only if stated (toolkit 'ACT/ACT' = 365.25). JAWAB: 1) days. 2) remove Feb 29s for NL. 3) divide.

title: Curve time vs accrual fraction separation
deliverables: per-cashflow table: accrual yf, curve t, DF, PV
frame: DIKETAHUI: cash flows; leg day count; curve basis (ACT/365F). DITANYAKAN: amount from accrual basis, DF from curve time. RUMUS: card Conventions: never mix. JAWAB: 1) accrual yf (leg). 2) t (curve). 3) DF = exp(-z t). 4) PV.
formulas: PV = N r yf_leg exp(-z t_curve)

title: Rate conversion between ACT/360 and ACT/365 quotes
frame: DIKETAHUI: rates in one basis. DITANYAKAN: equivalent rate in other basis. RUMUS: same interest: r_365 = r_360 365/360. JAWAB: 1) convert. 2) check amount equality.

title: IMM dates (third Wednesday) for futures
frame: DIKETAHUI: start date; count n; months cycle. DITANYAKAN: next n IMM dates. RUMUS: third Wednesday of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec. JAWAB: 1) next cycle month. 2) day 15-21 Wednesday. 3) list.

title: CDS standard roll dates (20th of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec)
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade date; tenor. DITANYAKAN: CDS maturity and premium schedule. RUMUS: maturity = next 20 Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec + tenor (semi-annual roll since 2015: Mar/Sep); accrual ACT/360, Following. JAWAB: 1) roll. 2) dates. 3) yf. 4) premium amounts.

title: FX option expiry from delivery date
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade date; option tenor; pair calendars. DITANYAKAN: expiry and delivery. RUMUS: Clark ch.1: delivery = spot + tenor (MF); expiry = delivery - spot lag (good days) (for month tenors); day tenors from trade date. JAWAB: 1) spot. 2) delivery. 3) expiry. 4) checks.

title: Leap-year anchors (Feb 29) in schedules
frame: DIKETAHUI: anchor Feb 29; annual freq. DITANYAKAN: rolled dates. RUMUS: anchor + k years clips to Feb 28 in non-leap years; EOM applies if anchor month end. JAWAB: 1) roll from anchor. 2) clip. 3) adjust.

title: Sum of year fractions over a schedule check
deliverables: summary json: sum yf, tenor, diff
frame: DIKETAHUI: schedule; basis. DITANYAKAN: sum of fractions vs tenor. RUMUS: card Invariants: 30/360 exact, ACT/360 slightly > tenor. JAWAB: 1) yf. 2) sum. 3) compare.

title: Single vs joint calendar for payments
frame: DIKETAHUI: dates; holiday sets per center; rule. DITANYAKAN: adjusted dates under joint calendar. RUMUS: good day = good in all centers. JAWAB: 1) union. 2) adjust. 3) compare.

title: T-bill discount yield, money-market yield and bond-equivalent yield
deliverables: per-bill table: price, discount yield, mmy, bey
frame: DIKETAHUI: bills: face, price or discount rate, days to maturity. DITANYAKAN: price and yields. RUMUS: P = F(1 - d days/360); MMY = (F/P - 1) 360/days; BEY = (F/P - 1) 365/days (<= 182 days). JAWAB: 1) price. 2) MMY. 3) BEY. 4) check d < MMY < BEY.

title: ACT/ACT ISDA over a multi-year period with stub
frame: DIKETAHUI: periods spanning several years. DITANYAKAN: ISDA fractions. RUMUS: card Core 2 per period. JAWAB: 1) segment per calendar year. 2) sum. 3) check.

title: Tenor arithmetic: ON, TN, SN, weeks, months, years
frame: DIKETAHUI: trade date; spot lag; tenors. DITANYAKAN: start/end per tenor. RUMUS: ON: today->+1bd; TN: +1bd->spot; SN: spot->+1bd; W: spot + 7n days (Following); M/Y: spot + months (MF, EOM). JAWAB: 1) spot. 2) per tenor. 3) adjust.

title: Settlement shifted by holiday: accrued effect
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades over a holiday. DITANYAKAN: adjusted settle and AI. RUMUS: settle = trade + lag good days; AI from PCD to adjusted settle. JAWAB: 1) settle. 2) AI. 3) compare to unadjusted.

title: Daily accrual schedule
deliverables: daily table [D]: date, daily interest, cumulative
frame: DIKETAHUI: notional, rate, start, end, basis. DITANYAKAN: daily accruals. RUMUS: daily = N r / basis per calendar day (weekends accrue). JAWAB: 1) date range. 2) daily amount. 3) cumsum. 4) check total = N r yf.

title: Swap fixed leg conventions by currency
frame: DIKETAHUI: currency list; swaps. DITANYAKAN: conventions per leg. RUMUS: card Conventions swaps (USD SOFR annual ACT/360; EUR annual 30/360 vs 6M ACT/360; GBP annual ACT/365F; JPY semi ACT/365F; CHF annual 30/360). JAWAB: 1) lookup. 2) schedule. 3) yf.

title: Deposit value date and maturity with currency spot lag
deliverables: per-trade table: value, maturity, days, yf
frame: DIKETAHUI: deposits: currency, trade date, tenor. DITANYAKAN: value and maturity dates and fraction. RUMUS: card Conventions GBP T+0; USD/EUR T+2; MF EOM. JAWAB: 1) lag. 2) value date. 3) maturity. 4) yf.
